vendor: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (Qwen), pay-as-you-go, Singapore region
status_note: Not tested by us. Everything here is copied from the vendor's pages on the dates given; run `python -m rak.models control qwen` before relying on it.

claude_code.why: min: the kit's hooks need onFailure: block (2.1.295+). pin: the version the kit was last developed against (2026-11-01); not tested with this endpoint by us.

limits.text: the key must match the base URL and region, otherwise 401 invalid_api_key; the base URL ends in /apps/anthropic with no /v1
without hasCompletedOnboarding: true in ~/.claude.json, Claude Code tries to reach api.anthropic.com
models marked "Upcoming deprecation" return 403 AccessDenied while still listed; there is no model-list endpoint

Token Plan and Coding Plan use other hosts and other model names (Token Plan: qwen3.8-max, qwen3.8-flash, qwen3.6-flash; Coding Plan: qwen3.7-plus); the FAQ lists further hosts without explaining the difference
Anthropic does not support routing Claude Code to non-Claude models; treat every Claude Code upgrade as untested until the positive control passes

data_policy.where: international regions: Singapore, US, Frankfurt, Hong Kong, Tokyo
data_policy.retention: "no longer than 30 days"; zero retention on approval
